args.summary: checkout-api health checks began failing after the v2.3.1 deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified; v2.3.1 was never healthy and should not be redeployed without change-manager approval. Root cause investigation of the v2.3.1 failure is pending.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after health check failures

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:** Deployment history showed the latest deploy **v2.3.1** was unhealthy in production, while **v2.3.0** was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1-rc was only a staging deploy). I rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback status confirms the service is now healthy with a low error rate (0.2%).

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the health check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: since v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, redeploying it would require change-manager approval under the org policy — root cause investigation is flagged in the incident.
